params = dict(value)

onChange.script:
#	system.perspective.print("selector params change script called")	
	params = self.custom.params
	
	if params is None: return
	if not params.has_key('data') or params['data'] is None or params['data'].rowCount == 0: return	#system.perspective.print("Data not set. Exiting")	
	if not params.has_key('path'): return # system.perspective.print("No path. Exiting")
		
	try:
		if currentValue.value['path'].value is None: self.custom.setPath = True
		elif currentValue.value['path'].value != previousValue.value['path'].value:	self.custom.setPath = False
	except:
		self.custom.setPath = False
		
	if self.custom.setPath: return	#Prevent flooding system.perspective.print("setPath is true. Exiting")	
	
#	system.perspective.print("selector params change script called with %s"%params)	
	if params['path']:
		paramsData = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(params['data'], str(params['treePath']), None)
		if paramsData.has_key(params['path']):	#Might be set to a value that is not selectable and not passed in the dataset
			payload = {'activity': 'nodeSelected', 'selection': [{'value': paramsData[params['path']]}], 'msgHandler': params["msgHandler"], 'selectorId': self.custom.selectorId}
			self.getChild("root").sendUpdate(payload)
#		else:
##			system.perspective.print("Clearing selection")		
#			self.custom.selection = []
#			self.custom.path = None
	else:
#		system.perspective.print("Clearing selection")		
		self.custom.selection = []
		self.custom.path = None
		
	self.custom.setPath = True	#Prevent flooding
		
	return

config.script:
#Look the node up gateway-side instead of using event.selectedData, which has been through the browser and loses the dataset's types (dates etc.)
	selection = []
	if event.selectedPath:
		node = None
		for section in event.selectedPath.split("\\"):
			matches = [n for n in (node['children'] if node else self.props.items) if n['label'] == section]
			if not matches: break
			node = matches[0]
		if node is not None: selection = [{'value': node['data']}]
	
	payload = {'activity': 'nodeSelected', 'selection': selection, 'msgHandler': self.view.custom.params.msgHandler, 'selectorId': self.view.custom.selectorId}
	self.parent.sendUpdate(payload)
	
	return

customMethods.name: sendUpdate
customMethods.script:
#	system.perspective.print('sendUpdate calling with view msgHandler: %s'%(payload))
	selection = [{'value': item['value']} for item in payload["selection"]]
	if self.view.custom.params.msgHandler:
		system.perspective.sendMessage(self.view.custom.params.msgHandler, {'activity': payload['activity'], 'selection': selection, 'msgHandler': payload["msgHandler"], 'selectorId': payload["selectorId"]})

	self.view.custom.selection = selection
	self.view.custom.path = selection[0]['value'][self.view.custom.params.treePath] if len(selection) else ''
		
	return

messageHandlers.script:
if payload.has_key('selectorId') and self.view.custom.selectorId == payload['selectorId']: 
		system.perspective.print('updateSelection() msg rcvd by %s with payload: %s'%(self.view.params.values.msgHandler, payload))		
		self.sendUpdate(payload)
		
	return

#We set this flag to prevent flooding between the embedded view and this view.
#	system.perspective.print("resetSelector msg handler rcvd with %s"%payload)
	if payload.has_key('msgHandler') and self.view.params.values.get('msgHandler') == payload['msgHandler']:
		self.view.custom.setPath = False
		self.view.custom.selection = []
		self.view.custom.path = ''		
	
	return
